events.action: {"message": "Fixed the defect in `tests/subsys/modem/backends/tty/src/main.c` where `test_receive_ready_event_raised` called `k_yield()` instead of `k_sleep(TEST_MODEM_BACKEND_TTY_OP_DELAY)`.
